category: 基本經濟概念/Basic economic concepts
questionText:
某非牟利機構把一幅空地劃分成多塊小型耕地，以抽籤方式分配予居民，為期一年。中籤居民在該年內可獨自使用所獲的耕地，並可把種出的蔬菜自用或出售。與把整幅空地開放予所有居民自由耕種比較，下列哪些是這項安排最可能帶來的結果？
(1) 中籤居民較有誘因為所獲的耕地施肥及保養。
(2) 耕地被過度使用的情況會減少。
(3) 該幅空地不再屬於稀少資源。
A non-profit organisation divides a piece of vacant land into small farming plots and allocates them to residents by lot for one year. During the year, a successful resident has sole use of the plot and may consume or sell the vegetables grown. Compared with opening the whole piece of land for all residents to farm freely, which of the following is/are the most likely result(s) of this arrangement?
(1) Successful residents have a greater incentive to fertilise and maintain their plots.
(2) Overuse of the farmland will be reduced.
(3) The piece of land is no longer a scarce resource.

category: 基本經濟概念/Basic economic concepts
questionText:
下列哪些例子與「生產甚麼？」這個基本經濟問題有關？
(1) 某農場以採摘機取代人手採摘士多啤梨。
(2) 中秋節過後，某餅店停止製造月餅，改為多造蛋撻。
(3) 政府把一個露天停車場改建為公園。
Which of the following examples is/are related to the basic economic problem "What to produce?"
(1) A farm replaces manual picking of strawberries with picking machines.
(2) After the Mid-Autumn Festival, a bakery stops making mooncakes and makes more egg tarts.
(3) The government converts an open-air car park into a park.

category: 基本經濟概念/Basic economic concepts
questionText:
嘉欣星期六有以下三個選擇，但只可選其一：
• 到咖啡店兼職，工資 $420；
• 替學生補習，收入 $450，但須自付來回交通費 $60；
• 出席一整天的攝影課程。
她早前已為攝影課程繳付了不可退還的訂金 $100；若出席，當日須再繳付 $200。最後她選擇出席攝影課程。她出席課程的機會成本是多少？
Ka Yan has the following three options on Saturday but can choose only one:
• work part-time at a café for a wage of $420;
• tutor a student for $450, but she has to pay $60 for her return transport;
• attend a one-day photography course.
She has already paid a non-refundable deposit of $100 for the course. If she attends, she has to pay another $200 on the day. She finally chooses to attend the course. What is the opportunity cost of attending the course?

category: 競爭與市場結構/Competition and market structure
questionText:
某受價廠商一直在利潤極大化的產量生產。若工人的工資率上升，而其產品的市價維持不變，假設該廠商繼續生產，其產量會 ____，而其所生產最後一單位產品的邊際成本會 ____。
A price-taking firm has been producing at its profit-maximising output. Suppose the wage rate of its workers rises while the market price of its product stays unchanged. If the firm continues to produce, its output will ____ and the marginal cost of the last unit it produces will ____.

options.A:
減少 …… 維持不變
decrease ...... remain unchanged
options.B:
減少 …… 上升
decrease ...... increase
options.C:
維持不變 …… 上升
remain unchanged ...... increase
options.D:
減少 …… 下降
decrease ...... decrease

category: 廠商與生產/Firms and production
questionText:
下表顯示某廠商在使用 3 部機器的情況下，僱用不同數目工人的總產量。
根據上表，下列哪項是正確的？
The table below shows the total output of a firm when it employs different numbers of workers with 3 machines.
According to the table, which of the following is correct?

options.A:
由第二名工人開始出現邊際回報遞減。
Diminishing marginal returns set in with the second worker.
options.B:
僱用第三名工人時，勞力平均產量開始下降。
The average product of labour starts to fall when the third worker is employed.
options.C:
僱用第五名工人時，該廠商出現規模負經濟。
The firm experiences diseconomies of scale when the fifth worker is employed.
options.D:
由第三名工人開始出現邊際回報遞減。
Diminishing marginal returns set in with the third worker.

category: 廠商與生產/Firms and production
questionText:
下列哪項措施最可能提高勞力的地域流動性？
Which of the following measures would most likely increase the geographical mobility of labour?

options.A:
政府資助失業人士修讀物流業的再培訓課程。
The government subsidises unemployed persons to take retraining courses in the logistics industry.
options.B:
大型僱主把員工的退休年齡由 60 歲延至 65 歲。
Large employers raise the retirement age of their staff from 60 to 65.
options.C:
政府為往新發展區工作的僱員提供一年租金津貼。
The government provides a one-year rent allowance to employees who move to work in a new development area.
options.D:
政府提高法定最低工資水平。
The government raises the statutory minimum wage.

category: 廠商與生產/Firms and production
questionText:
某上市電動渡輪製造商因連年虧損而清盤，其資產不足以償還所有債務。下列哪些陳述是正確的？
(1) 該公司的債券持有人較普通股股東優先獲得償還。
(2) 股東須以個人財產償還該公司未清還的債務。
(3) 股東的損失最多為其購入股票所付的款項。
A listed electric-ferry manufacturer is wound up after years of losses, and its assets are insufficient to repay all its debts. Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(1) The company's bondholders are repaid before its ordinary shareholders.
(2) Shareholders have to repay the company's outstanding debts with their personal assets.
(3) A shareholder's loss is at most the amount paid for his shares.

category: 廠商與生產/Firms and production
questionText:
下列哪些屬於第三級生產？
(1) 某航拍公司為婚禮提供空中拍攝服務。
(2) 某工廠裝嵌無人機。
(3) 某店舖維修損壞的無人機。
Which of the following belong(s) to tertiary production?
(1) An aerial photography company provides aerial filming services for weddings.
(2) A factory assembles drones.
(3) A shop repairs damaged drones.

category: 廠商與生產/Firms and production
questionText:
某連鎖茶葉專門店收購另一間規模相若的連鎖茶葉專門店。這項收購最可能的動機是
A chain of tea shops takes over another chain of tea shops of similar size. The most likely motive for this takeover is

options.A:
確保茶葉原料的供應穩定。
to secure a stable supply of tea leaves as raw materials.
options.B:
確保茶園出產的茶葉有銷售渠道。
to secure sales outlets for the tea leaves produced by tea plantations.
options.C:
經營互不相關的業務以分散風險。
to spread risks by running unrelated businesses.
options.D:
大量採購茶葉以享有規模經濟。
to enjoy economies of scale through bulk purchase of tea leaves.

category: 競爭與市場結構/Competition and market structure
questionText:
下表顯示某受價廠商的總成本。若市價為每單位 $13，該廠商在短期內會
The table below shows the total cost of a price-taking firm. If the market price is $13 per unit, in the short run the firm will

options.A:
生產 3 單位，虧損 $6。
produce 3 units and incur a loss of $6.
options.B:
停止生產，虧損 $15。
shut down and incur a loss of $15.
options.C:
生產 4 單位，虧損 $7。
produce 4 units and incur a loss of $7.
options.D:
生產 3 單位，賺取利潤 $9。
produce 3 units and earn a profit of $9.

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:
新生產技術令 LED 燈泡的生產成本下降。假設傳統燈泡是 LED 燈泡的代替品，LED 燈泡市場的交易量及傳統燈泡市場的均衡價格會如何改變？
New production technology lowers the cost of producing LED bulbs. Suppose traditional light bulbs are substitutes for LED bulbs. How will the quantity transacted in the market for LED bulbs and the equilibrium price in the market for traditional light bulbs change?

options.A:
LED 燈泡交易量：上升；傳統燈泡均衡價格：下降
LED bulbs – quantity transacted: increase; traditional bulbs – equilibrium price: decrease
options.B:
LED 燈泡交易量：上升；傳統燈泡均衡價格：上升
LED bulbs – quantity transacted: increase; traditional bulbs – equilibrium price: increase
options.C:
LED 燈泡交易量：下降；傳統燈泡均衡價格：下降
LED bulbs – quantity transacted: decrease; traditional bulbs – equilibrium price: decrease
options.D:
LED 燈泡交易量：上升；傳統燈泡均衡價格：不能確定
LED bulbs – quantity transacted: increase; traditional bulbs – equilibrium price: uncertain

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:
下表顯示美玲和志強購買每盒曲奇的邊際利益。曲奇的市價為每盒 $40，假設二人只會購買整盒曲奇。下列哪些陳述是正確的？
(1) 美玲購買曲奇的盒數多於志強。
(2) 美玲的消費者盈餘大於志強的消費者盈餘。
(3) 若市價升至每盒 $50，志強的消費者盈餘的減幅大於美玲的減幅。
The table below shows May's and Keung's marginal benefits from buying boxes of cookies. The market price of cookies is $40 per box. Assume they buy whole boxes only. Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(1) May buys more boxes of cookies than Keung.
(2) May's consumer surplus is greater than Keung's.
(3) If the market price rises to $50 per box, the decrease in Keung's consumer surplus is greater than that in May's.

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:
下表顯示濾水器市場的需求表及供應表。政府向生產者提供每部 $12 的從量補貼。下列哪些陳述是正確的？
(1) 補貼後，濾水器的交易量增加 60 部。
(2) 補貼後，最後一部濾水器的邊際成本高於其邊際利益。
(3) 補貼後，消費者在濾水器上的總支出上升。
The table below shows the demand and supply schedules of water purifiers. The government provides a unit subsidy of $12 per purifier to producers. Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(1) After the subsidy, the quantity transacted of water purifiers increases by 60 units.
(2) After the subsidy, the marginal cost of the last purifier is higher than its marginal benefit.
(3) After the subsidy, consumers' total expenditure on water purifiers increases.

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:
越來越多超級市場安裝自助收銀機；與此同時，大批收銀員退休。收銀員勞工市場的工資率及就業人數會如何改變？
More and more supermarkets install self-checkout machines. At the same time, many cashiers retire. How will the wage rate and the number of cashiers employed change?

options.A:
工資率下降，就業人數下降。
The wage rate falls and the number employed falls.
options.B:
工資率上升，就業人數不能確定。
The wage rate rises and the number employed is uncertain.
options.C:
工資率不能確定，就業人數下降。
The wage rate is uncertain and the number employed falls.
options.D:
工資率不能確定，就業人數不能確定。
Both the wage rate and the number employed are uncertain.

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:
下圖顯示新鮮榴槤的直線需求曲線。下列哪項是正確的？
The diagram below shows the straight-line demand curve for fresh durians. Which of the following is correct?

options.A:
價格由 $100 降至 $60 時，消費者在榴槤上的總支出下降。
When the price falls from $100 to $60, consumers' total expenditure on durians decreases.
options.B:
在 S 點，需求的價格彈性等於 1。
At point S, the price elasticity of demand is equal to 1.
options.C:
價格由 $60 降至 $30 時，需求屬高彈性。
When the price falls from $60 to $30, the demand is price elastic.
options.D:
在 R 點與在 T 點，需求的價格彈性相同。
The price elasticity of demand is the same at point R and at point T.

category: 競爭與市場結構/Competition and market structure
questionText:
下列哪些是壟斷性競爭廠商與寡頭壟斷廠商的共同特徵？
(1) 廠商是尋價者。
(2) 廠商在定價時須考慮競爭對手的反應。
(3) 廠商可透過廣告增加對其產品的需求。
Which of the following is/are common feature(s) of a monopolistically competitive firm and an oligopolistic firm?
(1) The firm is a price searcher.
(2) The firm has to consider its rivals' reactions when setting its price.
(3) The firm may increase the demand for its product through advertising.

questionText:

questionText:
下列哪些政策主要旨在促進機會均等化？
(1) 政府資助殘疾人士購買輔助器材，令他們可應徵更多類型的工作。
(2) 政府向所有 65 歲或以上長者一次性發放 $4 000 現金。
(3) 立法禁止僱主以年齡為理由拒絕聘用求職者。

(1) The government subsidises persons with disabilities to buy assistive devices so that they can apply for a wider range of jobs.
(2) The government gives a one-off cash payment of $4 000 to everyone aged 65 or above.

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:

category: 市場與價格/Market and price
questionText:

The number of pitches at a privately run campsite is fixed and cannot be increased in the short run. A newly launched bus route increases visitors' demand for these pitches. In the short run, how will the equilibrium price, the quantity transacted and the producer surplus of the pitches change?

options.A:
價格：上升；交易量：不變；生產者盈餘：上升
Price: increase; quantity transacted: unchanged; producer surplus: increase
options.B:
價格：上升；交易量：上升；生產者盈餘：上升
Price: increase; quantity transacted: increase; producer surplus: increase
options.C:
價格：上升；交易量：不變；生產者盈餘：不變
Price: increase; quantity transacted: unchanged; producer surplus: unchanged
options.D:
價格：上升；交易量：不變；生產者盈餘：不能確定
Price: increase; quantity transacted: unchanged; producer surplus: uncertain

options.A:
該廠商在 2025 年製造、於 2026 年售出的梳化
sofas made by the maker in 2025 and sold in 2026
options.B:
該廠商在越南廠房製造的梳化
sofas made in the maker's factory in Vietnam
options.C:
本地零售商從外地進口後在港轉售的梳化的全部售價
the full selling price of imported sofas resold by local retailers
options.D:
該廠商在 2026 年製造、但年底仍未售出的 30 張梳化
the 30 sofas made by the maker in 2026 but still unsold at the end of the year

(1) Only licensed banks may operate current accounts and savings accounts.

category: 貨幣與銀行/Money and banking
questionText:
某偏遠小島的村民以一包包白米作為交易媒介。下列哪些陳述是正確的？
(1) 白米不能有效發揮價值的儲藏功能，因為白米可能會變壞。
(2) 以白米作交易媒介可解決雙重需求偶合的問題。
(3) 由於白米本身是物品，它不能作為延遲支付的標準。
Villagers on a remote island use bags of rice as a medium of exchange. Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(1) Rice does not serve well as a store of value because it may spoil.
(2) Using rice as a medium of exchange can solve the problem of double coincidence of wants.
(3) Rice cannot serve as a standard of deferred payment because it is a commodity.

questionText:

(1) 貨幣供應定義一（M1）增加 30 萬港元。

Before maturity, he sells it at face value to another licensed bank and deposits all the proceeds into his current account with a licensed bank. Other things being equal, which of the following statements is/are correct?
(1) M1 increases by HK$300 000.
(2) M2 remains unchanged.
(3) M3 increases by HK$300 000.

questionText:

questionText:

proportional ...... tax payment

category: 貨幣與銀行/Money and banking
questionText:

(2) 公眾把部分借得的款項以現金形式持有，沒有存回銀行。
(3) 借款人把借得的款項全數存入另一間銀行，而非原本借出款項的銀行。
Which of the following would cause the deposits actually created by the banking system to be less than the maximum amount calculated from the required reserve ratio?
(1) Banks hold excess reserves.
(2) The public keeps part of the money borrowed as cash instead of depositing it back into banks.

questionText:

options.C:

(1) Restaurants have to reprint their menus frequently to update prices.
(2) People hold less cash and hence have to go to the bank to withdraw money more often.
(3) Lenders of fixed-rate loans lose and borrowers gain because of inflation.

questionText:

Which of the following must be true?

本地居民總收入必定大於本地生產總值。

category: 宏觀經濟問題和政策/Macroeconomic problems and policies
questionText:
K 國現時出現通縮差距。政府考慮以發行債券融資推行以下其中一個方案，兩者涉及的金額相同：
方案甲：向低收入在職住戶發放一次性津貼。
方案乙：增加購買本地建造服務以興建公共設施。
假設其他因素不變，下列哪項是正確的？
Country K is currently experiencing a deflationary gap. The government is considering one of the following two schemes, each involving the same amount of money and financed by issuing bonds:
Scheme I: giving a one-off allowance to low-income working households.
Scheme II: buying more local construction services to build public facilities.
Other things being equal, which of the following is correct?

options.A:
兩個方案都會直接計入本地生產總值中的政府開支。
Both schemes are directly counted as government expenditure in GDP.
options.B:
方案甲對總需求的最終影響較方案乙大，因為津貼直接交到住戶手上，可即時用於消費。
Scheme I has a larger final impact on aggregate demand than Scheme II, because the allowance goes directly to households and can be spent at once.
options.C:
方案甲屬轉移支付，因此對總需求沒有影響。
Scheme I is a transfer payment and therefore has no effect on aggregate demand.
options.D:
方案乙對總需求的初始影響較方案甲大，因為受惠住戶會把部分所得津貼儲起。
Scheme II has a larger initial impact on aggregate demand than Scheme I, because the recipient households would save part of the allowance received.
